mise.description: Tools are declared as `latest` and pinned by mise.lock instead, which .github/workflows/bump-tools.yml advances daily. Renovate has nothing to bump here, and enabling it would only produce PRs that fight the lockfile.

packageRules.description: Workflow action bumps are reviewed together, so batch them into one PR instead of one per action. Renovate regenerates .github/workflows/actions.lock in that PR, so no digests are pinned in the workflows themselves and no pinDigest rule is needed.
